title: Alien Dictionary
description: In an alien language, surprisingly, they also use English lowercase letters, but in a different alphabetical order. Given a sequence of `words` and the alien `order`, return `true` if words are sorted lexicographically in this language, or `false`.
input_format: First line contains `n` and `order` (26 unique chars). Following `n` lines contain the words.

sample_tests.explanation: 'd' comes after 'l' in alien order so word cannot precede world.

hints: Map each alien character to its index/weight in a hash map.
Compare adjacent word pairs character by character.
If word1 is a prefix of word2 but longer, order is invalid.
